verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de's API can create a notarization request for an uploaded document, manage signers, and auto-detect signature fields, with webhooks reporting completion. An agent could therefore submit an externally drafted NDA for signing via API. However, this is a notarization workflow rather than general e-signature routing, and the product offers no drafting or templating capability. Missing for 10: NDA drafting or template generation, plain e-signature routing (not just notarization), an MCP server, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and hands-on corroboration of an agent-driven end-to-end flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent draft an NDA and route it for signature end-to-end via the product's API or MCP server

citations.quote: This endpoint creates a notarization request for a document
Signature and location/date fields will be automatically identified across the entire document using AI-powered detection.
businesses can submit documents, manage signers, and automate notarization workflows
